rule: TypeScript HTTP errors preserve the provider's code: usage_not_included is not_included, usage_limit_reached and rate_limit_exceeded or status 429 are rate_limit. The shared HTTP cases otherwise keep their messages and reset times. respond's ResponseError also carries the HTTP status and only the Retry-After header, so callers can retry 429 without adding request headers or other response headers to the error.
